title: aazmaya hua naam kaam agaya
body:
aazmaya hua naam kaam agaya zoufe mid'hat ko yu'n mud'dua milgaya
ya ali keh ke maine uthaya qalam mad'he abbas ka housla mil gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ne abbas ka waasta de diya , meri taqdeer me jo na tha mil gaya
jo hamesha se qismat ke qaa'il rahe, un ko kaise bataau ke kya mil gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ne baabul hawaaij ko aawaz di, panjetan ka dare faiz waa hogaya
ek waseele se kitne waseele mile,jo bhi maanga tha is se siwa mil gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
roze mehshar qayamat ki thi tashnagi, aur deedare saaqi ki lou thi lagi
naame abbas le kar mai aage badha, taaba kousar mujhe raasta mil gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ali o wali ho ke abbas ho, naam badle magar kaam badla nahi
jab bhi mushkil kusha ki zarurat hui, is gharaane me mushkil kusha mil gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ali murtaza mazhare kibriya, aur abbas hai mazhare murtaza
mujhko abbas ka aastaa'n kya mila, taaba maabood ek silsila mil gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jab wafa ka kahi'n tazkera chid gaya, baat pohanchi beher haal abbas tak
justaju karne walo ko manzil mili, chaaand ki chandni se pata milgaya
<<DIVIDER>>
aasma'n me hai roushan zamee'n ka qamar, aur zamee'n par roushan ali ka qamar
yu'n zamee'n ko jo hasil hua ye sharaf, aasmaa'n se bada madeena mil gaya
